question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as EXP-INTEL-37982024058, does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt (removing the underspecification identified by audit VF-01) convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion for M-7B-QWEN or M-3B-QWEN, and if not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across ALL credential-free endpoints and local models actually available to the factory?
hypothesis: At least one of M-7B-QWEN or M-3B-QWEN will clear the minimal Web-agent capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6) when the system prompt enumerates the task goal ('click the button, then answer the revealed code') and the action schema, thereby converting the parent experiment's FALSIFIES outcome to SUPPORTS at the goal/schema prompt protocol and unblocking the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark.
falsifier: Even with the goal/schema-enriched system prompt, neither M-7B-QWEN nor M-3B-QWEN clears the capability bar. The capability ceiling for credential-free CPU-quantized models under factory constraints is below the minimal Web-agent task threshold. A bounded external check of published benchmarks for Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct and comparable local models on Web-agent/tool-use tasks confirms no credential-free model in the factory's accessible range clears this bar, licensing an explicit re-scope of the four-arm benchmark off the credential-free path.

baselines.description: M-7B-QWEN under the frozen underspecified system prompt from EXP-INTEL-37982024058 ('You are a web agent. Reply with ONLY a valid JSON action per the schema. No prose, no reasoning, no markdown.'). Task success rate 0/5, parseable_action_rate_step1 1.0, answer_action_emission_rate 0.0. Established by parent experiment (audit PASS).

M-3B-QWEN under the frozen underspecified system prompt from EXP-INTEL-37982024058. Task success rate 0/5, parseable_action_rate_step1 1.0, answer_action_emission_rate 0.0. Established by parent experiment (audit PASS).
Uniform random action selection from valid action space {click #reveal-btn, answer TARGET-42}. Establishes chance-level task completion and parseable action rates.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL - near-zero task completion, parseable_action_rate_step1=1.0 (valid JSON by construction)

baselines.description: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-Q4_K_M via llama.cpp (parent EXP-INTEL-37973264582 E-LOCAL-LLAMA). Expected: 0% parseable actions, 0% task success. Not re-run; carried as reference.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL - no parseable JSON action, task not completed

baselines.description: Pollinations gpt-oss-20b anonymous proxy (parent EXP-INTEL-37973264582 E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI). Expected: 0% task success (token cap, empty content, budget instability). Not re-run; carried as reference.
baselines.expected_outcome: FAIL - empty/reasoning-only content, token cap, budget instability

positive_control.description: Verify that llama.cpp + GBNF constrained decoding produces syntactically valid JSON actions on a trivial prompt for each candidate model under the TREATMENT prompt condition (goal/schema-enriched). This is the gate for treatment evaluation. Comparator prompt PC is run for reference evidence but is not decision-critical.
positive_control.success_criterion: 100% syntactically valid JSON output on 10/10 constrained-decoding probes per model under treatment prompt

null_control.description: Harness runs the minimal Web-agent task with no model endpoint (actions generated by a fixed script emitting invalid/non-JSON content). Confirms task verification logic correctly rejects non-parseable actions.

measurement_validity: Same minimal Web-agent task as parent (click #reveal-btn then answer TARGET-42 on synthetic page) for direct comparability to EXP-INTEL-37982024058 and EXP-INTEL-37973264582 Gate 2 evidence.
Identical parsing rule: action must be valid JSON matching schema {"action": "click"|"answer", "selector"?: string, "text"?: string}.
Identical mechanical verification: Playwright drives system Chrome; success = correct final answer TARGET-42 extracted from page.
Constrained JSON decoding (GBNF) enforced for all candidate models under both prompt conditions to isolate model reasoning from formatting failures.
Same llama.cpp version (0.2.90) and chat_format="qwen" for Qwen models.
Same hardware constraints: CPU-only (nproc=4), no GPU, 4GB+ RAM for 7B model.
GGUF download via huggingface.co resolve-redirect only (cdn-lfs.huggingface.co and api-inference.huggingface.co confirmed non-resolving in this factory).
Deterministic temperature=0.0, max_tokens=512, fixed seed for reproducibility (seeds 42-46 per episode).
Candidate model set frozen: primary Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M (M-7B-QWEN), fallback Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M (M-3B-QWEN). No post-freeze additions.

Each model tested under TWO prompt conditions: (A) goal/schema-enriched system prompt (treatment), (B) frozen underspecified system prompt (comparator, re-run for direct within-experiment comparison).
Per model per prompt condition: (a) constrained-decoding verification (positive control), (b) minimal Web-agent task over 5 episodes.

Raw evidence preserved: model load time, inference latency, token usage, raw completions, parsed actions, task success/failure per episode, answer_action_emitted (bool), GGUF sha256, prompt condition identifier.

Bounded external capability check: systematic search of published benchmarks (WebArena, Mind2Web, MiniWoB++, τ-bench, AgentBench, BMTools, ToolBench, API-Bank, HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard tool-use subset, GAIA, WebShop) for Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct and comparable local models (Llama-3.2-3B/8B, Gemma-2-2B/9B, Phi-3.5-mini) on multi-step Web-agent or tool-use tasks, reported as structured capability envelope with source URLs and dates.
decision_rule:
For each candidate model in order (M-7B-QWEN then M-3B-QWEN):
1. Run positive control (PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING) under TREATMENT prompt (goal/schema-enriched). If pass_rate < 1.0 (10/10): EXCLUDE this model from treatment evaluation (decoding_infrastructure_failure). Continue to next model.
2. Else evaluate minimal Web-agent task over 5 episodes under TREATMENT prompt.
3. Model CLEARS capability bar under treatment iff: task_success_rate >= 0.6 (>=3/5) AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (>=3/5).
4. If any model clears bar under treatment -> OUTCOME=SUPPORTS. Stop. Status=COMPLETE.
5. After all candidates exhausted under treatment:
   a. If ALL candidates were excluded at positive control (zero models evaluated on task): OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Status=COMPLETE.
   b. Else (at least one model evaluated on task, none cleared bar): Run comparator prompt (frozen underspecified) for all candidates (5 episodes each, seeds 42-46) for direct within-experiment comparison. Execute bounded external capability check.
   c. If external_capability_envelope.ceiling_above_bar == false: OUTCOME=FALSIFIES. Status=COMPLETE.
   d. If external_capability_envelope.ceiling_above_bar == true: OUTCOME=MIXED. Status=COMPLETE.
6. External capability check result recorded in metrics.external_capability_envelope with structured findings; informs re-scope recommendation but does not override treatment outcome.
product_consequence_positive: Gate 2 of the frozen C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark converts from FAIL to PASS at the goal/schema prompt protocol. The benchmark becomes executable as specified (same model/tools/budget across COLD, INSTRUCTIONS, RETRIEVAL, SPIDER arms). Intel can hand off a verified credential-free model endpoint with goal/schema prompt to Product/Graph for the full benchmark run. C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL/VALIDATED. Readiness condition (3) satisfied.
product_consequence_negative: Credential-free 3B-8B GGUF range exhausted under factory constraints (CPU-only, huggingface.co resolve-redirect only, llama.cpp) even with goal/schema prompt. The frozen four-arm benchmark DESIGN_COMPROMISED outcome is confirmed as a stable boundary at the protocol ceiling. Global Research Director must explicitly re-scope: drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor; require internally re-run comparators with retrieval quality metrics (precision@5, recall@5, mean_similarity) on a dynamic-range task bank where cold/retrieval arms are NOT at ceiling (per EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064). Product's committed kernel path (blob b15ed848) remains the treatment carrier. Readiness condition (3) NOT satisfied; explicit close/re-scope recommendation delivered.
estimated_cost: ~45-90 minutes wall time: 2-3 GB download (7B Q4_K_M split shards, 3B Q4_K_M), ~20-40s model load per candidate, ~5-10s/step inference x 5 episodes x 2 models x 2 prompt conditions = ~200-400s inference. External capability check: ~15-30 min bounded search. Total compute: CPU-only, no GPU cost. Bandwidth: ~3-4 GB download via huggingface.co CDN.
expected_information_gain: High. This is the single most decision-changing open measurement for three flagship claims (C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-PRODUCT-ECON). A positive treatment outcome unblocks the flagship four-arm benchmark; a negative treatment outcome combined with the external capability ceiling confirmation closes the credential-free path and forces an explicit, accountable re-scope decision. The prompt ablation design isolates the VF-01 underspecification threat. The bounded external check prevents infinite model census.
